findings.Recommendation: Add CSP with default-src 'self' and frame-ancestors 'none'
findings.Description: Add CSP with default-src 'self' and frame-ancestors 'none'
findings.Impact: Missing Content-Security-Policy significantly increases exploitability of XSS vulnerabilities.

Missing Strict-Transport-Security allows downgrade attacks and enables interception of traffic as this header lets a website tell browsers that it should only be accessed using HTTPS, instead of using HTTP.
Missing or insecure X-Content-Type-Options allows MIME-sniffing attacks, increasing XSS risk.
Missing or weak Cache-Control may expose sensitive information stored in browser cache.
Missing Referrer-Policy may cause the browser to leak sensitive URL information to external sites during navigation.
Missing COOP allows external sites to open and interact with the browsing context, increasing risks such as cross-origin attacks and tab-nabbing.
Missing COEP may allow the application to load untrusted cross-origin resources that are not opt-in, reducing the protection against cross-site data leaks.

findings.Recommendation: Restrict browser features such as camera, microphone, geolocation
findings.Description: Restrict browser features such as camera, microphone, geolocation

findings.Recommendation: Disable or mask the Server header through server configuration or by using a reverse proxy.
findings.Description: Disable or mask the Server header through server configuration or by using a reverse proxy.
findings.Impact: Reveals server software and version (for example: gunicorn/19.9.0), which enables attackers to search for version-specific vulnerabilities and targeted exploits.

findings.Detail: Error responses (404, 405) disclosed server information, including the server header cloudflare.
findings.Recommendation: Replace default error pages with custom error pages that do not expose server or framework information.
findings.Description: Replace default error pages with custom error pages that do not expose server or framework information.
findings.Impact: Default/error pages or verbose error responses may reveal internal paths, server versions, stack traces, or other internal details that aid attacker fingerprinting and exploitation.

findings.Description: HTTPS Not Enforced (No HTTP → HTTPS Redirect)
findings.Current Value: Plain HTTP requests are not redirected to HTTPS (or redirect not observed).
findings.Recommendation: Configure the server to redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS (301/307) and use HSTS.
findings.Impact: All data is transmitted in plaintext, allowing attackers to intercept credentials, session data, and sensitive information through man-in-the-middle attacks.
Without HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), attackers may force users to downgrade secure connections to HTTP, exposing traffic to interception.
